population: All archived BINARY markets with unambiguous YES/NO resolution by 2024-07-04T00:00:00Z; no selection by momentum or performance
deadline_requirement: A creation-time announced deadline with immutable timestamped provenance, and change history sufficient to rule out hindsight
t_rule: verified ex-ante deadline minus 24h; previous snapshot another 24h earlier
manual_audit_rule: First 12 binary YES/NO markets by SHA256(id) within the archival time population; inspect deadline fields and their provenance before any predictive fit
stop_rule: If the public snapshot cannot verify an ex-ante deadline, do not substitute resolutionTime or snapshot closeTime. Report non-conclusive feasibility, no model, no p value.
event_requirement: Audited common-event key; no event shared between train and test
models: Only if timing and event gates pass: train-only flexible calibration baseline vs same covariates plus delta; chronological held-out evaluation with event-cluster uncertainty
